version.description: The configuration schema version. Omitting it assumes the latest and warns.

config.description: A single unnamed build. Diagnostics call it `config`. Mutually exclusive with `configs`, which is ignored when this is present.

configs.description: Named or positional builds. A mapping keeps its names in diagnostics; a sequence is named `configs[0]`, `configs[1]`, and so on.

config.description: One independent translation build: its catalogs, the languages they must cover, and the files generated from them.

languages.description: The languages every key is expected to provide, and the JSON files to generate. Missing or empty means the union of languages found across all keys is expected instead.

allow.description: Lints suppressed for every key this config lints. A key's own `allow` list uses the same spelling.

strict.description: Promote lint warnings to errors, including the empty-languages, empty-inputs, and empty-outputs diagnostics.

check_templates.description: Validate that every template renders successfully.

dry_run.description: Report what would be written without writing any file.

print_absolute_paths.description: Print absolute paths in progress output and diagnostics instead of paths relative to the config file.

usages.description: The application sources this catalog belongs to, and how its keys may be referenced. Drives the `unused-key` and `dynamic-usage` lints.

roots.description: Source roots owned by this config, resolved relative to this configuration file. Empty disables unused-key checking unless `--usages` supplies roots, which replace these.

items.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

dynamic.description: How a translation call that builds its key at runtime is treated. `--dynamic-usages` overrides this.

oneOf.description: A known literal prefix keeps matching keys alive, and the call is not reported.
Accept the same prefixes, and report `dynamic-usage` for review.
Report `dynamic-usage` as an error, and do not let an inferred prefix keep keys alive.

functions.description: Callees whose first argument is a translation key. Replaces the defaults rather than extending them. A name without a dot also matches the final member of a callee, so `t` matches `i18n.t`; a dotted name must match the whole callee.

respect_ignore_files.description: Apply `.ignore` rules while discovering sources. `--no-ignore` overrides this.

respect_gitignore.description: Apply `.gitignore`, Git's global excludes, and `.git/info/exclude` while discovering sources. `--no-gitignore` overrides this.

inputs.description: The translation catalogs this config reads.

input.description: A catalog path or glob, or a mapping that also says how its keys are prefixed.

oneOf.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

path.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

exclude.description: Paths or glob patterns removed from what `path` matched.

oneOf.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

items.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

prefix.description: Prepended to every key read from this input.

prepend_filename.description: Prepend each file's stem to its keys, keeping catalogs from colliding.

prepend_relative_path.description: Prepend each file's path relative to this input's root to its keys.

separator.description: Joins the prefix segments. Defaults to `.`.

outputs.description: The files generated from this config's catalogs. Output paths are resolved relative to this configuration file.

paths.description: One path or a list of paths, resolved relative to this configuration file.

oneOf.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

items.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

jsonOutputs.description: One JSON output or a list of them. `{{language}}` in a path expands to each configured language.

oneOf.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

path.description: A path or glob pattern, resolved relative to this configuration file.

style.description: The layout of the generated JSON.

oneOf.description: A flat `translations` map keyed by fully qualified translation key.

typescriptOutput.description: Generated TypeScript declarations for the catalog.

allowEntry.description: A namespaced lint suppression. `lint:all` suppresses every lint.

templateEngine.description: The template engine used to parse and validate translation templates. Any other engine name is accepted and treated as unknown to the built-in checks.
